purpose: Define explicit negative/pruning selections that remove components from a candidate profile while requiring dependency closure to remain valid.

topics.name: Boot Negative Pruning
topics.purpose: Define explicit negative/pruning selections that remove components from a candidate profile while requiring dependency closure to remain valid.

semantics.prune_rule: Negative selection targets exact component/capability identities.
semantics.precedence_rule: Conflict between positive selection and explicit prune is resolved by a declared deterministic profile rule; never by order of appearance.
semantics.required_rule: A component required by a retained component cannot be pruned while preserving an invalid closure.
semantics.optional_rule: Optional components may be pruned when no retained required dependency is broken.
semantics.cascade_rule: Pruning does not silently cascade-delete dependents; resulting invalid dependents are reported explicitly.
semantics.history_rule: Pruning affects resolved profile availability, not installed-artifact history.
semantics.authority_rule: Pruning availability does not modify permissions.

invariants.rule: Boot/runtime availability is derived only from explicit profile selection plus validated dependency closure; discovery, installation, dependency presence or historical activation never silently enables a component.

hard_gates.condition: negative/positive conflict resolved by list order

references.purpose: Positive and negative profile selection reconcile explicitly.
